lines.text: Ahaziah falls through a lattice in Samaria and sends messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, whether he will recover.
The messengers tell the king a hairy man with a leather belt met them, and he knows it was Elijah.
The king sends a captain with fifty men to Elijah, who sits in a cave, and fire consumes them.

wrong_details.true: sitting on top of a hill

lines.text: The third captain falls on his knees and begs for mercy, and the angel of the LORD tells Elijah not to be ashamed of him.

wrong_details.wrong: not to be ashamed of him
wrong_details.true: not to be afraid of him

lines.text: Elijah tells Ahaziah to his face that he will surely die, and Jehoram succeeds him because he has no son.
